name: Rings scUSD
oneLiner: scUSD is Rings' wrapper minted from supported stablecoins routed through Veda BoringVault DeFi strategies; yield is activated by staking into stkscUSD.
collateral: Stablecoin deposits routed through Trevee (formerly Rings) / Veda BoringVault infrastructure into curated DeFi lending strategies (e.g. Aave, Morpho); supported collateral includes USDC, USDT, DAI, GHO, and Sonic USDC.e
pegMechanism: Users deposit supported stablecoins to mint scUSD and redeem scAssets after a documented cooldown period; yield is primarily activated by staking scUSD into stkscUSD rather than by holding liquid scUSD itself.

notices.title: On-chain reserve tracking pending
notices.message: Live reserve tracking for scUSD is pending Trevee/Rings publishing canonical BoringVault and treasury backing addresses. Check https://docs.trevee.xyz/trevee-earn/sonic-scassets/treasury-backing-address for the latest published addresses.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: scUSD is minted against stablecoin deposits routed through a managed reserve vault and DeFi lending strategies.
